s: Din arba ammot birshut harabbim ubo v' seipim: kol adam yesh lo d' ammot birshut harabbim sheyyakol letaltel bahem, shenneemar "shebu ish tachtayv", velamedu mippi haqqabbala shezzeh neemar leinyan tiltul, shello yetaltel kol adam birshut harabbim ella kemiddat "tachtayv", dehaynu kemiddat orek gupo, shehu g' ammot veamma kede lipshot bah yadayv veraglayv. Lepikak modedim lo beamma shello, dehaynu (mimmarpeqo (sheqqorin elinebbogi"n bilshon idish) ad rosh etzba haarukka hanniqret amma al shem zeh). Haggadol lepi godlo vehaqqatan lepi qotno, shehare bed' ammot shello yesh bahen kede peshitut orek gupo veyadayv veraglayv. Veim hu nannas beebarayv, dehaynu sheammato qetanna vegupo gadol, venimtza shello yaspiqu lo d' ammotayv — notenim lo d' ammot benoniyyot shel kol adam, shekkol achat mehen shishsha tepachim. Uben shemmodedin lo ammot benonit, uben shemmodedin lo ammot shello — modedin otan metzumtzamot lehachamir:

Arba ammot sheameru — hen vaalaksonan, dehaynu alakson shel d' al d' shehu h' ammot veg' chumshe amma, lepi shebbemigreshe hearim shehen merubbaim veyesh lahem zaviyyot, shehare neemar bahem "et peat negeb vego'" u"pea" hi zaviyyot, neemar bahem "zeh yihyeh lahem vego'", vedareshu chakamim kezeh yihyeh kol shobete shabbat, kegon reshut hayyachid shehu d' al d' yihyeh gam ken merubba shettihyena bo zaviyyot, veken alpayim shel techum shabbat hen merubbaot velo agullot kede sheyyistakker hazzaviyyot. Vegabbe haabara d' ammot birshut harabbim, shello shayyak ribbua veiggul, tzarik sheyyehe sham haalakson shel ribbua, shehaalakson hu haodep sheyyesh bemeshek hammerubba mechamat hazzaviyyot. Veyesh mi sheomer shemmid' ammot ad Hashem veg' chomashim patur abal asur middibre soperim, [ve]yesh lachush lidbarayv. Abal tok d' muttar lekattechilla apillu littol mittechillat d' ulehanniach besop d', raq shello yotzi chutz led':

Hammaabir d' ammot birshut harabbim eno chayyab ella im ken heebir bahalika achat, abal im amad betok d' ammot vechazar vehalak — patur. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheamad lapush, abal amad letaqqen massao — hare zeh kimhallek. Umiddibre soperim asur lehotzi chepetz chutz led' ammot apillu beomed o yosheb lapush tok d' ammot, o apillu manniach hachepetz baaretz tok d' ammot vechozer umoliko chutz led' ammot, gezera shemma yaabirennu d' ammot bahalika achat. Vaapillu bekarmelit gazeru al zeh beitztzumo shel yom, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman shn"b, abal beben hashshemashot lo gazeru al zeh bekarmelit apillu lidbar hareshut. Abal birshut harabbim gazeru al zeh apillu beben hashshemashot, apillu lidbar mitzva, lepi shebbeqal yukal labo lide issur shel tora, sheyyaabirennu d' ammot bahalika achat. Veken mittaam zeh gazeru al hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim al yede "zeh oqer vezeh manniach" apillu beben hashshemashot lidbar mitzva, veken al hotzaa kilachar yad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"t:

Vekol zeh kesheadam echad motzi hachepetz chutz led' ammot, ella sheoseh hannacha benetayim. Abal muttar lo leadam laaqor chepetz mereshut harabbim velitteno lachabero sheetzlo betok d' ammotayv, vachabero yittenennu lachabero sheetzlo, ap al pi shehachepetz holek kamma milin birshut harabbim, kevan shekkol echad eno maabir d' ammot. Ubilbad shello yotziu hachepetz chutz litchum hair sheqqana bah hachepetz shebita, ella im ken hu chepetz shel hepqer sheeno qoneh shebita kelal:

Umikkol maqom, en hetter zeh — shennoteno lachabero vachabero lachabero — moil ella leinyan tiltul chutz led' ammot bekarmelit o birshut harabbim, abal lo leinyan tiltul mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit (apillu im echad omed bipnim veechad bachutz, vezeh shebbipnim moshit hachepetz vezeh shebbachutz notelo miyyado, shezzeh oqer vezeh manniach — ap al pi ken asur middibre soperim apillu bekarmelit, vaapillu lidbar mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"a, ella im ken mishshum bizyon kitbe haqqodesh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a):

Hayu shenayim, miqtzat ammotayv shel zeh betok shel zeh, kegon sheyyesh benehen v' ammot — mebiin veokelim baemtza, ubilbad shello yotzi kol echad mittok shello letok shel chabero. Hayu shelosha, vehaemtzai mubla benehem, kegon shebben b' hachitzonim shemoneh ammot — haemtzai muttar im kol echad mehachitzonim bemah shed' ammot shello mubla betok shellahem, vehem asurim zeh im zeh:
